Crime & Law · India

Human Trafficking Networks Targeted in India and Globally

Multiple law enforcement agencies across India have conducted raids targeting human trafficking and sex rackets in various states, including West Bengal, Haryana, Bihar, Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Madhya Pradesh. These operations have led to the rescue of dozens of victims, including minors, and numerous arrests. Some investigations are linked to international networks, including those involving Cambodia, and have uncovered cyber slavery operations.
